create.name: Yuval Ron
create.bio:
Yuval Ron is an Israeli-born composer, oud player and teacher of sacred music, based in Los Angeles. He leads the Yuval Ron Ensemble, which brings together Jewish, Sufi, Christian and Armenian musical traditions, and he has written scores for film, dance and theatre, including the Oscar-winning short West Bank Story. Since 1990, when he composed binaural music for the Monroe Institute, he has worked with neuroscientists, healers and spiritual teachers on music for meditation and wellbeing, and he founded the Metta Mindfulness Music label and the Inspired Sound Initiative, a non-profit offering arts programmes to young people.

His teaching draws on the sacred sound practices of several traditions: Sufi chanting and zikr, Kabbalistic and Hebrew prayer, Nada Yoga, Qi Gong's six healing sounds and Middle Eastern musical modes, alongside research on how sound affects the brain. He has taught at the Esalen Institute since 2009 and lectured at universities such as Yale, MIT, UCLA and Berklee. Divine Attunement: Music as a Path to Wisdom, a book of his with a foreword by Pir Zia Inayat-Khan, tells stories of mystics and musicians from many faiths and won an Indie Book Award in 2015. On The Shift Network he teaches a course on Sufi mystical sound traditions.

books.title: Divine Attunement: Music as a Path to Wisdom
books.author: Yuval Ron
books.description: Through parables, essays and personal reflections, Yuval Ron explores ecstatic sound and ritual movement in Sufi, Kabbalistic, Gnostic Christian and Zen traditions. It retells stories of mystics such as Rumi and the Baal Shem Tov and ends with meditative music and movement exercises.

courses.title: Sufi Mystical Sound Traditions
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on the history, ritual and philosophy of Sufi sacred music. It teaches traditional chants, zikr and silent remembrance, sama, the Near Eastern musical modes and sacred movement, with some of the research on how sound affects the brain.

courses.title: Mystic Heart: Sacred Hebrew Music and Mysticism Webinar Series
courses.description: Recorded webinar sessions on sacred Hebrew music and the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, each focused on practices for one or two sephirot, starting with Keter. Access to each video is sent by email after a donation.

flags: Not to be confused with a different Yuval Ron, a progressive-rock guitarist (yuvalron.com, YouTube 'Yuval Ron', Instagram @yuval.ron.music); only accounts linked from yuvalronmusic.com are used.

Most of his own channel (342 videos) is music-only ensemble and concert footage, left out as the brief says; the videos kept are talks and interviews, mostly on other channels, all with low view counts except the TEDx talk (8.2k).

His Ojai retreat 'Resilience Through Sacred Healing Sounds' (14–19 March 2027, in-person $1,845, online $500 per his YouTube trailer) was left out because its event page on his site now returns 404; it may be cancelled or moved.

Sufi Mystical Sound Traditions kept: the course itself names no condition, but its sales page FAQ and a testimonial mention stress, anxiety, pain and COVID in passing; the description here leaves them out.

Much of his wider work is framed as music for healing and brain health (40 Hz sound, 'music medicine', Metta Music Medicine Series); all such items were left out, so the listing rests on his sacred-music teaching.
yuvalronmusic.com has a broken SSL certificate (only valid for mail. and webmail. subdomains), so website links may show a browser warning.
left_out: Music-only videos (ensemble performances, solo oud, album trailers, concert promos) and videos under ~2 minutes.

Yuval Ron at the Shift 2023 Healing Sound Summit (own channel): description names dementia, Alzheimer's and chronic pain. Harmonic Path to Hope: The Power of 40 Hz Sound Therapy; Ancient Music Was Used As Medicine; The Latest on Brain Health and Sound Healing; The Most Healing Music Is Based On Nature (principles of musical medicine): health or medicine framing.
Shift Network livestreams (Discover a Harmonic Path to Hope; Explore Sufi Mystical Sound Traditions): on the hub's channel.
Healing Sounds of the Wisdom Traditions webinar series (University of Sufism, $250 USD): class descriptions say the practices alleviate anxiety and depression.
Healing Sounds of the Abrahamic Faiths master program (University of Sufism, June 2025 to March 2027): already started.

Workshops page offerings (Sound Healing of the Doshas, Sacred sound practices for resilience, Music and the Brain): booked by presenters with no dates or prices, and descriptions name depression, anxiety, immunity.
Ojai retreat (March 2027): event page returns 404. New Shift professional training (January 2027): no page or URL yet.
Mentorship programme for composers: a music-industry apprenticeship, not spiritual teaching.
Albums, DVDs and the Spanish edition of Divine Attunement (Afinación Divina): music products or no Amazon ASIN checked.
No free resources found that are evergreen and free (store webinars are by donation).
